story_text:
Help Osslo Jewelry Project move to its next chapter from long research journey
The Project’s Story for 25years of Bio Noble Metals
I would like to allow me to mention to you that I could write down of my long story about this project during the past 20years, for understanding this project and my life duty.
In 2000,
Since 2000, I have worked about Dental Noble alloy, and in 2002, I could see that gold price would go up very higher price within some years. So that, I had a plan to make new noble alloy that could be replaced of gold alloy, and I had conducted to search about all dental and medical alloy of the world in 2004. As the searching, I had realized unsolved & impossible alloy' technologies that I researched.
In 2005~2008
I started to research for success the tech in 2005. But I could not overcome the metallurgical challenge that discover key Elements and Raw Materials for reducing Thermal Expansion of the alloy and alloy' structuring to stabilize Sulfur till 2009 year.
In 2009~2013
One time, I had an illness that prevented me from standing up and that even doctors could not cure. So that, I had to lay down on bed for three months. I believe that the cause of the illness is, that I knew someone else's future and mentioned it to the person and others, for fun and interest, and that another reason of that, all of works have a price. After my physical condition improved, I began to analyze deeply again about solutions of the topics I had been researching. In the meantime, I was able to recognize the solution's hint for those technologies, like an inspiration, with someone's(?) guidance, as if it was passing through my head, and I was able to have completed the detail technologies in 2013 through my numerous trials & experiments with the hint, started since 2004.
Failed & Great Test Pic (2010~2012)- For Jewelry Alloy
When I fell down and was frustrated by impossible attempt, only the someone (?) was the guide who helped me to get back up, by telling me that the experiment would be succeeded. Because this researching uses expensive precious metals, like Gold, Platinum, Palladium, Silver, Iridium, Rhodium, Osmium, ETC, as research' materials. So, it can be expected to occur huge costs that would be unimaginable for a personal small company. However, I could get some solution about the huge costs' problem with the someone (?)' help on the process of experimentation. and the answers were always in my earnest prayers forward sincerity in my life.
The Product' real Pics
In 2014
With the technology of stabilizing sulfur in alloy, I was able to sell new products for four years (2010~2014). However, the technology created jealousy and envy towards me among the competitors in the market, and their attempts to stop(close) my company. In the end, due to limited funding and expected precious metals' high price within a few years, I had to close the company in Korea.
Before closing down my company in Korea, I received from the someone's (?) guidance regarding fund as a night dream. The dream was about lottery numbers, but I was only given 5 numbers, not all 6 numbers, so that, I did not attempt to purchase the lottery tickets, because my considering that the dream could ask my choice. If I had chosen to buy a lottery tickets, I could have secured some money, but I'm pretty sure I would have dead or no longer involved in this technology within a few years due to the choice of the dream.
Osslo Jewelry Brand Launch Show' Catalog in S.Korea in Feb. 2014
In 2015~2019
After the Korean company closed, I spent several months in Shenzhen, China, researching the jewelry market with a Chinese Government-owned company called Guodunji (that owns 2,000 department stores in China). Meanwhile, I was guided and recommended by the someone (?) to go to the United States. Following the guidance, I came to the United States in 2015, received Green Card (permanent residency) under NIW (Nation Interest Waiver) as a core scientist, and conducted market research in the United States until 2019. If I had not followed the guidance and stayed in China, I would not have been able to attempt for the commercialization of the technology as now. The reason is that the price of palladium has skyrocketed since 2016, due to the issue of Diesel Gate of Germany' Volkswagen.
(Attention Returns to the World’s First Alternative Technology for Gold)-Koea IT Times in 2015 (http://www.koreaittimes.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=45440)
Introducing Osslo GoldenSilver Jewelry Noble alloy in New York Jewelry Show in 2018
In 2019~Now
I expected that the unexpected surge of palladium' price would be stabilized and tried to secure for restarting the company in 2019. However, due to the pandemic and personal things, my attempts to secure funding could only begin in 2023.
Still, With the technology, I had to meet lots of tech thieves and fraudulent.
But always I was sure to meet great person for commercializing the technology at one day as same as when I researched the tech in my lab as following his(?) hint.
Reach out the technology detail on www.BioNobleMetals.com
Wishes (all of works) have a price (repayment) that I must fulfill.
Whatever the price, I would have vowed to pay it, even if it means all of my life and death.
I don't have any contemporary religion. However, I also do not know whether the someone (?) who have been guiding me, is random god (just Ghost) or absolute God. But I could know through him, that in this world, we must live with sincerity and earnest, and that each person has his or her own duties in life that are given to him/her at the birth. I recognize that commercializing of this technology is my life's duty and purpose. I don't know what kind of reward and hope I can give to this world through my life. However, I am sure that if this small technology is commercialized, everyone involved will be happy, also, that I would show that a person has to faithfully follow and live the life that has been given and could find a little hope in that life.
---
I realize that your help should be my best, since 2004 when I started to research. It took 20 years with many countless failures and setbacks to get to this moment, that 10 years of researching and 10 years of waiting for proper time. However, I think that being able to reach the peak in one field, is the greatest of all life's pleasures.
I will overcome any troubles, difficulties with you and move forward quietly without fear.
And I should remind of recited my poem below in jewelry’ launching show in Feb. 2014.
---
“The failure of the... countless times!
God allowed the alloy..!"
​
The sweat of true passion gathered on his forehead.
The sweat of countless fell on the desk.
The heat of passionate researcher vaporized the sweat away into the sky.
The sweat' steam gathered and gathered in the sky
A drop of rain got down on the ground
One work is born like that...
​
It seems to be so fortunate that the beginning can see the end.
We won't neglect anything big or even small.
We couldn't know how our way is but we'll follow the given way quietly without fear.
​
We would like to leave a little echo in the hearts and world through the simple technologies.
We welcome as the wish that all persons to be always with happiness and blessing.”
---
Sincerely, I will create a wonderful masterpiece in the world with you on this blank sheet.
I attach Test Pictures (Fail and Completed) of the alloy for showing you my trials and delight that I have been conducted the experiments.
I appreciate your reading of my long story and your deep understanding of the technology.
